scripts.redeploy: docker-compose down -v && docker-compose up -d && sleep 5 && npx serverless deploy
scripts.update-api-id: API_ID=$(awslocal apigateway get-rest-apis --query 'items[0].id' --output text) && sed -i "s/const API_ID = '.*';/const API_ID = '$API_ID';/" ./web/index.html && echo "Updated API_ID to: $API_ID"
scripts.deploy-all: npx serverless deploy && npm run update-api-id && npm run deploy-frontend-fixed-bucket
